description: This file implements a media session client for UWP on Raspberry Pi 4, handling media playback state changes, media control button events, and communication with other components via callbacks.

methods.name: MediaSessionPlaybackStateToMediaPlaybackState
methods.description: Converts internal media session playback state to Windows MediaPlaybackStatus.

methods.name: OnMediaSessionStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in media session state, updates UI controls, and manages display requests.

methods.name: RegisterMediaSessionCallbacks
methods.description: Registers callbacks for media session actions and state updates.

methods.name: UpdateActiveSessionPlatformPlaybackState
methods.description: Updates platform playback state via callback.
